name: ADHD Clinic — Complete Automation (Email Triage + Calendar Booking)

nodes.name: 📬 Gmail — Watch New Emails
nodes.notes:
Single entry point for the entire system.
Polls every 60 seconds for new unread emails.
Every email — whether an enquiry, booking request, or confirmation reply — enters here.
Unread only to prevent duplicate processing.

nodes.name: 🔧 Normalize Email Data
nodes.notes:
Unpacks the raw Gmail object into clean labelled fields.
Extracts: senderEmail, senderName, firstName, subject, body, threadId, receivedAt.
Also detects if this is a reply to a previous email (isReply flag).
All downstream nodes rely on this consistent shape.

nodes.name: 🚨 Safety Filter
nodes.notes:
Scans every email for dangerous language before anything else runs.

3 categories checked:
1. Legal & Complaint: solicitor, legal action, ombudsman, GDPR breach...
2. Safeguarding: abuse, neglect, domestic violence, police, social services...
3. Crisis & Risk: suicide, self-harm, overdose, crisis, not safe...

If ANY match found → isFlagged = true → hard stop, admin alert, NO reply ever sent.
Uses code not AI — 100% deterministic, zero chance of missing a keyword.

nodes.name: ⚡ Is Safety Flagged?
nodes.notes:
Hard gate — the most important branch in the entire workflow.
True (flagged) → red alert to admin, full stop.
False (clean) → AI classification.

nodes.name: 🔴 Alert Admin — Safety Flag
nodes.notes:
Sends a red HTML alert to admin for any flagged email.
Includes: flag type, trigger words, sender details, full email body.
Workflow ends here for flagged emails — no further processing.

values.content: You are an AI assistant for a private ADHD clinic. Your job is to classify incoming emails into the correct category AND detect the intent. Return ONLY valid JSON. No markdown. No explanation. No code fences.

=Analyse this email and return a JSON classification.

Subject: {{ $json.subject }}
Body: {{ $json.body }}
Is Reply Email: {{ $json.isReply }}

Return this exact JSON structure:
{
  "intent": one of ["booking_request", "booking_confirmation", "booking_cancellation", "enquiry", "manual_review"],
  "category": one of ["adult_adhd_assessment", "child_adhd_assessment", "follow_up", "medication_query", "gp_shared_care", "general_enquiry", "manual_review"],
  "confidence": number 0.0 to 1.0,
  "reasoning": "one sentence",
  "firstName": "patient first name if found, else empty string",
  "isChild": true or false,
  "gpName": "GP name if mentioned else empty string",
  "location": "city or area if mentioned else empty string",
  "mentionsPrice": true or false,
  "mentionsWaitingTime": true or false,
  "appointmentType": "plain English description of appointment needed",
  "preferredDate": "any date or time preference mentioned else empty string"
}

Intent rules:
- booking_request: patient wants to book a NEW appointment
- booking_confirmation: patient is replying YES to a slot we proposed (isReply=true + yes/confirm/that works/option 1/perfect)
- booking_cancellation: patient wants to cancel an existing appointment
- enquiry: question, information request, template-based reply needed
- manual_review: anything ambiguous or confidence below 0.75

Category rules (only relevant when intent=enquiry):
- adult_adhd_assessment: adult seeking ADHD assessment
- child_adhd_assessment: enquiry about child ADHD assessment
- follow_up: existing patient following up
- medication_query: questions about medication or prescription
- gp_shared_care: from a GP or about shared care arrangements
- general_enquiry: anything else
- manual_review: ambiguous

nodes.name: 🤖 AI — Classify & Detect Intent
nodes.notes:
THE CORE AI NODE — does two jobs in one call:

1. Detects INTENT: is this a booking request, booking confirmation, cancellation, or general enquiry?
2. Classifies CATEGORY: if it's an enquiry, which type is it?

Combining both into one AI call saves tokens, reduces latency, and avoids two separate API calls.

GPT-4o at temperature 0.1 = consistent, predictable JSON output every time.
Confidence < 0.75 → manual_review enforced in the parse node.

nodes.name: 🧩 Parse AI Response
nodes.notes:
Parses and validates the AI JSON response.
Handles: markdown-wrapped JSON, malformed JSON, missing fields, low confidence.
Every failure mode → manual_review. The workflow never crashes here.
Also picks the best firstName between AI detection and sender name parsing.

nodes.name: 🔀 Master Router
nodes.notes:
The master routing node — splits the workflow into 4 branches:

1. booking_request → find available calendar slots → propose to patient
2. booking_confirmation → finalise booking in Google Calendar
3. booking_cancellation → remove from Google Calendar
4. enquiry → classify by category → select template → auto-reply
5. fallback (manual_review) → alert admin, no reply

nodes.name: 📅 Prepare Slot Search
nodes.notes:
Prepares the 14-day search window for finding available calendar slots.
If patient mentioned a preferred date, search starts from that date.
Outputs calendarSearchFrom and calendarSearchTo for the Google Calendar query.

nodes.name: 📅 Get Available Slots
nodes.notes:
Searches the consultant's Google Calendar for events titled 'Available' in the next 14 days.
REPLACE: calendarId with actual consultant calendar ID.
Consultants mark open slots as 'Available' or 'Available 10:00-11:00' in their calendar.
Returns up to 20 results ordered by start time — we take the first 3.

nodes.name: 🗓️ Build Slot Proposal
nodes.notes:
Picks the 3 earliest available slots and builds a natural proposal email.
Formats dates in UK style: 'Monday, 24 February 2026 at 10:00–11:00'
If no slots found → noSlotsFound = true → admin is alerted instead.
Stores all slot IDs and times for use when the patient confirms.

nodes.name: ⚡ Slots Found?
nodes.notes:
True (no slots) → alert admin to add availability and handle manually.
False (slots found) → send proposal email to patient.

parameters.subject: =📅 Manual Booking Needed — No Slots Available | {{ $json.senderName }}
parameters.message:
=

📅 No Available Slots Found

Patient: {{ $json.senderName }} <{{ $json.senderEmail }}>

Appointment Type: {{ $json.appointmentType }}

Preferred Date: {{ $json.preferredDate || 'Not specified' }}

Message:

{{ $json.body }}
No available slots found in Google Calendar for the next 14 days. Please add availability and reply to this patient manually.

nodes.name: 🟡 Alert Admin — No Slots
nodes.notes:
Alerts admin when no available slots exist in the next 14 days.
Admin should: add 'Available' events to the consultant's Google Calendar, then reply to patient manually.

nodes.name: 📤 Send Slot Proposal
nodes.notes:
Sends the 3-option slot proposal to the patient.
Replies within the same Gmail thread so conversation stays tidy.
Patient replies with 'Option 1' or 'Option 2' to confirm.

nodes.name: 📊 Log Booking Request
nodes.notes:
Logs the booking request to the Bookings tab.
Status = SLOTS_PROPOSED (will update to CONFIRMED when patient replies).
Thread ID stored — used to match the confirmation reply back to this record.

nodes.name: 🔍 Detect Chosen Slot
nodes.notes:
Reads the patient's confirmation reply and detects which option they chose.
Checks for: 'Option 1', 'second option', 'yes', 'that works', 'sounds good' etc.
If ambiguous → needsManualConfirmation = true → admin alert.
Prevents ever booking the wrong slot.

nodes.name: ⚡ Choice Clear?
nodes.notes:
True (unclear) → admin alert to handle manually.
False (clear) → proceed to create the Google Calendar appointment.

parameters.subject: =📅 Booking Confirmation Unclear | {{ $json.senderName }}
parameters.message:
=

📅 Manual Confirmation Needed

Patient: {{ $json.senderName }} <{{ $json.senderEmail }}>

Their reply:

{{ $json.body }}
Could not determine which slot the patient chose. Please confirm manually and book in Google Calendar.

nodes.name: 🟡 Alert Admin — Unclear Slot
nodes.notes:
Alerts admin when the patient's reply is ambiguous.
Includes their full reply so admin can read and book the correct slot.

nodes.name: 📋 Map Confirmed Slot
nodes.notes:
Maps the chosen option number to the correct slot start/end times.
Builds the Google Calendar event title: 'ADHD Assessment — Patient Name'

nodes.name: 📅 Create Calendar Appointment
nodes.notes:
Creates the confirmed appointment in Google Calendar.
Includes patient details, reminders (24hr email + 60min + 30min popup), private visibility.
Patient receives a Google Calendar invite automatically.

nodes.name: 🗑️ Delete Available Slot
nodes.notes:
Deletes the 'Available' event immediately after booking.
This is what prevents double booking — the slot disappears from the calendar the moment it's confirmed.
No other patient can be offered the same slot.

nodes.name: 📧 Send Booking Confirmation
nodes.notes:
Sends professional HTML confirmation email to patient.
Includes: appointment type, confirmed date/time (UK format), location, what to bring, cancellation policy.
CCs admin on every confirmed booking.
Replies in the same thread.

nodes.name: 📊 Update Sheet — Confirmed
nodes.notes:
Updates booking row from SLOTS_PROPOSED → CONFIRMED.
Stores the Google Calendar event ID for future reference.
Lookup by Thread ID links this confirmation back to the original booking request row.

nodes.name: 🗑️ Cancel — Remove from Calendar
nodes.notes:
Removes the appointment from Google Calendar when a patient emails to cancel.
The googleCalendarEventId should be retrieved from the Bookings sheet by threadId.
For production: add a Google Sheets lookup node before this to get the event ID.

nodes.name: 📧 Send Cancellation Email
nodes.notes:
Sends cancellation confirmation to patient.
CCs admin. Stays in the same thread.

nodes.name: 🔀 Route Enquiry by Category
nodes.notes:
Routes general enquiries to the correct template.
6 outputs: adult_adhd | child_adhd | follow_up | medication | gp_shared_care | general
Fallback → manual review alert.

nodes.name: 📝 Template — Adult ADHD
nodes.notes:
Adult ADHD Assessment template.
Paste your actual template in the marked section.
Auto-inserts waiting time / pricing / location paragraphs if patient mentioned them.
Update ccEmail to your adult ADHD consultant's address.

nodes.name: 📝 Template — Child ADHD
nodes.notes:
Child ADHD Assessment template.
Warmer tone directed at parents/guardians.
Update ccEmail to your paediatric consultant's address.

nodes.name: 📝 Template — Follow Up
nodes.notes: Follow-Up Enquiry template. Keep concise — existing patients need a quick acknowledgement.

nodes.name: 📝 Template — Medication
nodes.notes:
Medication Query template.
Never provides clinical advice. Directs to prescribing consultant.

nodes.name: 📝 Template — GP Shared Care
nodes.notes:
GP / Shared Care template.
Professional clinical tone. Auto-inserts GP name as 'Dr [Name]' if detected.

nodes.name: 📝 Template — General
nodes.notes: General Enquiry catch-all template. Warm and open.

nodes.name: 📤 Send Enquiry Auto-Reply
nodes.notes:
Sends the personalised auto-reply for all 6 enquiry categories.
All template branches merge into this single send node.
Replies in thread, CCs the relevant consultant/admin.
